facts.text: It was a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems under Chairman San Hill.

evidence.quote: It was a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems under Chairman San Hill.

facts.text: Muunilinst was a lush world of forests, plains, and tall, jagged mountain peaks, with its skies said to be the most beautiful in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Muunilinst was a lush world of forests, plains, and tall, jagged mountain peaks, with its skies said to be the most beautiful in the galaxy.

facts.text: It had a liquid iron core, a strong magnetic field, and was volcanically active throughout its known history.

evidence.quote: It had a liquid iron core, a strong magnetic field, and was volcanically active throughout its known history.

facts.text: Its shallow oceans contained hundreds of "smokers," which were conical volcanoes built up by powerful vents in the crust.

evidence.quote: Its shallow oceans contained hundreds of "smokers," which were conical volcanoes built up by powerful vents in the crust.

facts.text: The very cones surrounding these vents were made up of layers of precious metals, mixed in with the mollusks, tube-worms, and bioluminescent ferns nurtured by the heat and water.

evidence.quote: The very cones surrounding these vents were made up of layers of precious metals, mixed in with the mollusks, tube-worms, and bioluminescent ferns nurtured by the heat and water.

facts.text: The tall, gaunt Muuns were famous for their financial acumen, mathematical genius (hence the name Moneylend of their homeworld of Muunilinst), and greed.

evidence.quote: The tall, gaunt Muuns were famous for their financial acumen, mathematical genius (hence the name Moneylend of their homeworld of Muunilinst), and greed.

facts.text: Muun children could calculate complex formulas as quickly as most adults of other species.

evidence.quote: Muun children could calculate complex formulas as quickly as most adults of other species.

facts.text: Common Muuns rarely left the surface.

evidence.quote: Common Muuns rarely left the surface.

facts.text: There was also a Podrace course near the city of Pilaan.

evidence.quote: There was also a Podrace course near the city of Pilaan.

facts.text: The greatest Muun city was Harnaidan, the headquarters of a subdivision of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, as well as the planet's capital.

evidence.quote: The greatest Muun city was Harnaidan, the headquarters of a subdivision of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, as well as the planet's capital.

facts.text: Built around a series of magnificent spires reaching four kilometers into the sky, Harnaidan had a population of more than fifty million.

evidence.quote: Built around a series of magnificent spires reaching four kilometers into the sky, Harnaidan had a population of more than fifty million.

facts.text: It was built above caverns containing vast, naturally heated lakes and enormous hot springs heated by magma vents.

evidence.quote: It was built above caverns containing vast, naturally heated lakes and enormous hot springs heated by magma vents.

facts.text: Harnaidan was, unfortunately for the Muuns, mostly leveled during the battle in the Clone Wars as the Grand Army of the Republic's Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery blasted away buildings indiscriminately in order to annihilate Separatist forward positions.

evidence.quote: Harnaidan was, unfortunately for the Muuns, mostly leveled during the battle in the Clone Wars as the Grand Army of the Republic's Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery blasted away buildings indiscriminately in order to annihilate Separatist forward positions.

facts.text: A skyhook connected Harnaidan with High Port Space Center, an orbital city.

evidence.quote: A skyhook connected Harnaidan with High Port Space Center, an orbital city.

facts.text: Mariunhus was a particularly rich city built around a smoker rich in gold, platinum, and other precious metals.

evidence.quote: Mariunhus was a particularly rich city built around a smoker rich in gold, platinum, and other precious metals.

facts.text: Mariunhus was an example of a "vault-spire," a virtual mountain of wealth, kept safe and secure, which could be mined at a moment's notice to guarantee credit anywhere in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Mariunhus was an example of a "vault-spire," a virtual mountain of wealth, kept safe and secure, which could be mined at a moment's notice to guarantee credit anywhere in the galaxy.

facts.text: The former subjects of the Rakata during the time of the Infinite Empire, the Muuns eventually achieved their independence.

evidence.quote: The former subjects of the Rakata during the time of the Infinite Empire, the Muuns eventually achieved their independence.

facts.text: All throughout the Galactic Republic era, Muunilinst had a knack for funding potentially profitable enterprises throughout its sector, regardless of ethics or loyalty and was an economic rival of Coruscant itself.

evidence.quote: All throughout the Galactic Republic era, Muunilinst had a knack for funding potentially profitable enterprises throughout its sector, regardless of ethics or loyalty and was an economic rival of Coruscant itself.

facts.text: It provided much of the funding for the nearby Human colony world of Sartinaynian, which, ironically, broke away from the Republic because of anti-alien sentiments.

evidence.quote: It provided much of the funding for the nearby Human colony world of Sartinaynian, which, ironically, broke away from the Republic because of anti-alien sentiments.

facts.text: Eventually, both Muunilinst and Sartinaynian came to be member worlds in the Republic, and Muunilinst became one of the greatest financial powers in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Eventually, both Muunilinst and Sartinaynian came to be member worlds in the Republic, and Muunilinst became one of the greatest financial powers in the galaxy.

facts.text: When the Republic established the Galactic Credit Standard, the InterGalactic Banking Clan was its guarantor and distributor.

evidence.quote: When the Republic established the Galactic Credit Standard, the InterGalactic Banking Clan was its guarantor and distributor.

facts.text: The corruption of the Banking Clan was largely unchecked as the Republic fell into decline, and with the looming threat of the breakdown of law and order, they invested in thousands of Hailfire droids to discourage customers from defaulting on their loans.

evidence.quote: The corruption of the Banking Clan was largely unchecked as the Republic fell into decline, and with the looming threat of the breakdown of law and order, they invested in thousands of Hailfire droids to discourage customers from defaulting on their loans.

facts.text: Consistent with its reputation for playing both sides, Muunilinst simultaneously backed the currency of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Consistent with its reputation for playing both sides, Muunilinst simultaneously backed the currency of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: Alliances with the Confederacy, however, led to Separatist forces building droid factories and munitions depots on Muunilinst, over the objections of most of the native Muuns.

evidence.quote: Alliances with the Confederacy, however, led to Separatist forces building droid factories and munitions depots on Muunilinst, over the objections of most of the native Muuns.

facts.text: Desperate, they turned in secret to the Republic for aid, even while San Hill and the IGBC collaborated with the Separatists.

evidence.quote: Desperate, they turned in secret to the Republic for aid, even while San Hill and the IGBC collaborated with the Separatists.

facts.text: During the Battle of Muunilinst in 22 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Voolvif Monn retook the planet for the Republic, but at great cost.

evidence.quote: During the Battle of Muunilinst in 22 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Voolvif Monn retook the planet for the Republic, but at great cost.

facts.text: The Separatists fought savagely to hold the planet, with waves of battle droids and a special platoon of IG lancer combat droids led by Jedi hunter Durge.

evidence.quote: The Separatists fought savagely to hold the planet, with waves of battle droids and a special platoon of IG lancer combat droids led by Jedi hunter Durge.

facts.text: Confederate gun emplacements operated from within the cities, leaving Republic forces no choice but to assault the cities directly.

evidence.quote: Confederate gun emplacements operated from within the cities, leaving Republic forces no choice but to assault the cities directly.

facts.text: The battle devastated the Muun infrastructure and led the galaxy to the brink of financial ruin.

evidence.quote: The battle devastated the Muun infrastructure and led the galaxy to the brink of financial ruin.

facts.text: Sometime later, Muunilinst came back under Separatist control as at the end of the war, Separatist forces based here and at Mygeeto fled to the Ciutric sector and joined forces with pirates and Thalassian slavers.

evidence.quote: Sometime later, Muunilinst came back under Separatist control as at the end of the war, Separatist forces based here and at Mygeeto fled to the Ciutric sector and joined forces with pirates and Thalassian slavers.

facts.text: Muunilinst later became the financial center of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: Muunilinst later became the financial center of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: However, unlike other factions the CIS, the Empire wouldn't destroy the IGBC, as it would have set the galaxy into a great recession, but rather subjugated the government.

evidence.quote: However, unlike other factions the CIS, the Empire wouldn't destroy the IGBC, as it would have set the galaxy into a great recession, but rather subjugated the government.

facts.text: Many Imperials harbored no fondness for aliens, especially those who had associated with the Confederacy, but the mineral riches of Muunilinst were too important for the stability of Imperial credit.

evidence.quote: Many Imperials harbored no fondness for aliens, especially those who had associated with the Confederacy, but the mineral riches of Muunilinst were too important for the stability of Imperial credit.

facts.text: Muuns' lending and business operations were hampered by harsh Imperial decrees and the presence of Imperial monitors stationed throughout the world's financial institutions.

evidence.quote: Muuns' lending and business operations were hampered by harsh Imperial decrees and the presence of Imperial monitors stationed throughout the world's financial institutions.

facts.text: Muunilinst was no more loyal to the Empire than it was to the Republic or Confederacy, but found it expedient not to undermine Imperial power, reasoning that, no matter the outcome of the Galactic Civil War, the victor would be forced to keep doing business with the Muuns and the IGBC.

evidence.quote: Muunilinst was no more loyal to the Empire than it was to the Republic or Confederacy, but found it expedient not to undermine Imperial power, reasoning that, no matter the outcome of the Galactic Civil War, the victor would be forced to keep doing business with the Muuns and the IGBC.

facts.text: Muunilinst was part of the Imperial Remnant, the surviving portions of the Galactic Empire in the Outer Rim during the New Republic years, protected by two Golan III battle platforms.

evidence.quote: Muunilinst was part of the Imperial Remnant, the surviving portions of the Galactic Empire in the Outer Rim during the New Republic years, protected by two Golan III battle platforms.

facts.text: Consistent with their reputation, even while a part of the Imperial Remnant, Muunilinst still became the guarantor of the New Republic credit.

evidence.quote: Consistent with their reputation, even while a part of the Imperial Remnant, Muunilinst still became the guarantor of the New Republic credit.

facts.text: This infuriated the Moffs, but they were powerless to move against the IGBC without destabilizing the Imperial credit.

evidence.quote: This infuriated the Moffs, but they were powerless to move against the IGBC without destabilizing the Imperial credit.

facts.text: During the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy, the alien intruders attacked the Imperial Remnant, but the Empire managed to resist.

evidence.quote: During the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy, the alien intruders attacked the Imperial Remnant, but the Empire managed to resist.

facts.text: The planet itself was bombarded from orbit and devastated.
entities: The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant

evidence.quote: The planet itself was bombarded from orbit and devastated.

facts.text: By 40 ABY, Muunilinst had recovered, with it and Mygeeto functioning as financial centers of the then-Imperial Remnant's sphere of influence.

evidence.quote: By 40 ABY, Muunilinst had recovered, with it and Mygeeto functioning as financial centers of the then-Imperial Remnant's sphere of influence.

facts.text: This had continued with the Fel Empire and subsequently the Empire-in-exile but finally ended with the Galactic Federation Triumvirate.

evidence.quote: This had continued with the Fel Empire and subsequently the Empire-in-exile but finally ended with the Galactic Federation Triumvirate.

facts.text: In 44 ABY, during the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence, the Muunilinst system was the site of a three-way fleet battle between Imperial forces loyal to Head of State Jagged Fel and treacherous Moffs Woolbam and Callron.
entities: Battle of Muunilinst (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)

evidence.quote: In 44 ABY, during the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence, the Muunilinst system was the site of a three-way fleet battle between Imperial forces loyal to Head of State Jagged Fel and treacherous Moffs Woolbam and Callron.

facts.text: The Star Wars: Clone Wars designers made the Muunilinst cities look like neo-classical Greek structures hailing from U.S. dollar bills, as well as mimicking the currency's greenish tint.

evidence.quote: The Star Wars: Clone Wars designers made the Muunilinst cities look like neo-classical Greek structures hailing from U.S. dollar bills, as well as mimicking the currency's greenish tint.

facts.text: Harnaidan was the capital of and one of the largest cities on Muunilinst, and served as the headquarters of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. Its towers anchored a skyhook to the orbital city of High Port.

evidence.quote: Harnaidan was the capital of and one of the largest cities on Muunilinst, and served as the headquarters of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. Its towers anchored a skyhook to the orbital city of High Port.

facts.text: Mariunhus was a vault-spire on Muunilinst, one of the many small cities located out at sea, the foundations of which were built around the cones of active underwater smoker volcanoes. These volcanoes were known for spewing out superheated gases containing precious and pure metals.

facts.text: Munn City was a city on the planet of Muunilinst. It was the origin of a 22 BBY HoloNet News article on profits the InterGalactic Banking Clan garnered from their simplification of the process of establishing independent currencies.
